name: The GEF Small Grants Programme
description:
Established in 1992, the year of the Rio Earth Summit, the GEF Small Grants Programme embodies the very essence of sustainable development by "thinking globally acting locally". By providing financial and technical support to projects that conserve and restore the environment while enhancing people's well-being and livelihoods, SGP demonstrates that community action can maintain the fine balance between human needs and environmental imperatives.

SGP grants are made directly to community-based organizations (CBOs) and non-governmental organizations (NGOs) in recognition of the key role they play as a resource and constituency for environment and development concerns. The maximum grant amount per project is US$50,000, but averages around US$25,000. In this way, SGP complements the large and medium-sized GEF project funding by providing a window for the direct participation of NGOs, local communities, and other grassroots organizations.

name: Arcadia Funds - Environmental Grants
description:

We focus on four approaches: on-site conservation, off-site conservation, policy advocacy, and conservation leadership. 
We look for organizations with dynamic, sustainable and well researched programmes that can deliver our objectives of preserving endangered culture and nature and promoting open access.
In addition to grants that promote open access, it is a condition of our grants that all material resulting from our funding must be made available freely to all via the internet. Read more about how we promote open access and our open access and digital preservation policy.

name: Oceans 5
description:
Oceans 5 supports results-oriented conservation projects throughout the world.

We prefer time-bound efforts involving multiple organizations working toward common policy objectives. Our work focuses on projects to stop overfishing through fisheries management reforms and to establish marine protected areas (MPAs), among the two highest ecological priorities identified by marine scientists. We are inspired by project opportunities that can bring lasting benefits to coastal communities.

name: Arcadia Funds - Cultural Grants
description:
Our cultural grants to museums, archives and universities focus on documenting endangered heritage. Projects we fund record manuscripts and archives, archaeological sites and artefacts, and cultural and religious traditions at risk of being lost. We also help develop new technologies for heritage documentation and historical research. We enable free, online, open access to all these materials.
We look for organizations with dynamic, sustainable and well researched programmes that can deliver our objectives of preserving endangered culture and nature and promoting open access.
In addition to grants that promote open access, it is a condition of our grants that all material resulting from our funding must be made available freely to all via the internet. Read more about how we promote open access and our open access and digital preservation policy.

impact. In 2021, two awards will be given:
One award will recognize a researcher, or group of researchers, who has advanced understanding of food
production, processing, distribution, consumption, safety and/or human nutrition, with a significant positive
impact on society. Likely themes include: food science, the environmental impact of agriculture, crop or
livestock genetics, agro-ecology, soil health, food animal health and production, pest management, supply
chain management, food processing, food packaging, food safety, food consumption, human nutrition, food
retail/marketing.
The other award will recognize an individual, or group of individuals, who has contributed to improved
nutritional health and/or food security, with a focus on strengthening disadvantaged communities. Likely
themes include: food sovereignty, food production, food distribution/access, food insecurity, community
development and governance, household nutrition, urban poverty, Aboriginal food security, non-traditional
food systems, socioeconomic policy, empowerment of under-served communities, food and nutrition literacy

name: EURIPIDES² and PENTA Clusters call for projects
description:
The 2021 EURIPIDES²/ PENTA call contributes towards a simplification of the funding landscape and brings a wider range of countries and partners together through EURIPIDES², PENTA, and, where appropriate, co-labelled projects. It clarifies the funding choices that collaborative teams can access, helps to standardise submission processes and provide high quality support to projects. The PENTA mission is to catalyse research, development and innovation in areas of micro and nanoelectronics enabled systems and applications. Micro and nanoelectronics underpin the rapidly developing Digital Economy and are a cornerstone of key European & Global economic and societal developments. PENTA supports projects along the Electronic Components & Systems (ECS) value chain. PENTA programme is managed by AENEAS, an Industrial Association bringing together Large Enterprise, SME’s, Technology organisations and Academia.

EURIPIDES² promotes the generation of innovative, industry-driven, pre-competitive R&D projects in the area of Smart Electronic Systems Integration. EURIPIDES² covers the whole electronic systems integration value chain, from materials, equipment and technologies, components and modules, up to embedded, enmeshed and implanted systems.

name: Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) as actors of governance and development in the field
description:
The Action rolls out the EU support to country-level CSO initiatives aimed at implementing priorities reflected in the new European Consensus on Development which allows for the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Those priorities are: climate change; gender equality; youth; root causes of irregular migration and forced displacement; and crisis and fragility. Delegations will implement them whenever applicable, and will have to select at least one of these priorities for this Action. In particular, the second EU Gender Action Plan seeks to achieve sound progress in third countries. This implies concretely that 85% of the projects under this Action need to include a gender component or approach.
Likewise, the EU commitment to respond to the challenges and investment needs related to climate change requires dedicating at least 20% of the EU budget to climate change mitigation and adaptation actions. The support is also expected to help CSOs play their role in contributing to the goals of the Paris Agreement and the implementation of the Sendai Framework on Disaster Risk Reduction.
This Action document foresees support to all of Africa, Asia and the Pacific, Latin America and Caribbean, and Neighbourhood countries. This worldwide coverage allows for the adaptation of the programme to the specific needs of each country. For instance, it also supports CSOs as actors of governance in countries that have graduated from traditional development assistance, and in fragile countries.
This Action Document reflects the added value of the CSO-LA thematic programme at country level, in complementarity with the EIDHR and other instruments, in particular the bilateral programmes that include support to civil society.

description: Con esta colaboración estratégica única en su género, Johnson & Johnson Innovation quiere ofrecer una plataforma para que innovadores de todo el mundo se unan a JLABS Singapur y se enorgullece de lanzar el Singapore QuickFire Challenge.

name: Call for Nominations: Thieme-IUPAC Prize 2024
description: El Grupo Thieme, en colaboración con la Unión Internacional de Química Pura y Aplicada (IUPAC) y los editores de Synthesis, Synlett, Synfacts y Science of Synthesis, anuncian el Premio Thieme-IUPAC para 2024.

name: Sustainability Open Innovation Challenge 2023
description: La quinta edición del Desafío de Innovación Abierta sobre Sostenibilidad, organizado por Enterprise Singapore, reúne a socios industriales y busca mentes innovadoras para idear soluciones sostenibles que abarquen diversos sectores.

name: RWE Floating Wind Co-Use Competition
description: RWE, uno de los líderes mundiales en energía eólica marina, ha puesto en marcha su primer "Concurso de Co-utilización de Energía Eólica Flotante" a escala mundial. La empresa se dedica a acelerar el desarrollo y la demostración de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles.

name: Boyd N. Lyon Scholarship Program 2024
description: La Ocean Foundation y The Boyd Lyon Sea Turtle Fund buscan solicitudes para la beca Boyd N. Lyon, para el año 2024.

name: We are together International Prize for Social Change
description: apoyar iniciativas relacionadas con el cambio social a través del voluntariado.El Premio se otorga anualmente a ciudadanos y organizaciones independientemente de su país de residencia, nacionalidad, género, etc. La selección de los galardonados del Premio se realiza en 6 regiones del mundo : la CEI, Europa, la región de Asia y el Pacífico, Oriente Medio y Norte de África, América del Norte y del Sur, África Subsahariana.

name: Applications open for Stockholm Water Prize
description: The Stockholm International Water Institute has launched submissions for Stockholm Water Prize for people and organizations who have made outstanding contributions to the sustainable use and protection of the world’s water resources.

name: ProVeg Grants Program
description: ProVeg International busca solicitudes de subvención para ofrecer experiencia y apoyo a organizaciones de gran potencial centradas en la transformación del sistema alimentario.

name: Now Open: FPF x FPF Grant Program
description: La misión de la FPF es educar y capacitar a individuos y comunidades para que tomen el control de su privacidad y seguridad financiera, y promover un sistema financiero justo y equitativo que respete la privacidad personal.

name: BHS Student Grant Scheme
description: La Sociedad Herpetológica Británica acepta solicitudes para el Programa de Becas para Estudiantes (SGS).

name: Your Future in Green Jobs Mentorship Program
description: El Ban Ki-moon Centre for Global Citizens (BKMC), con el apoyo de Dubai Cares, y en colaboración con Plan International y Unbounded Associates, se complace en anunciar el lanzamiento del nuevo programa basado en la acción: Programa de tutoría Tu futuro en empleos verdes.

name: Photo Competition for UN World Oceans Day
description: El concurso anual de fotografía para el Día Mundial de los Océanos, organizado por las Naciones Unidas y comisariado por Ellen Cuylaerts y un jurado compuesto por personalidades de renombre mundial, ya tiene abierto el plazo de presentación de candidaturas.

name: SwedBio Funding Program for CSOs, International Organisations, Institutes & Universities
description: SwedBio agradece la presentación de notas conceptuales para apoyar un número limitado de iniciativas estratégicas a través de su "Collaborative Partner Implementation Pathway".

name: HICOOL Global Entrepreneurship Competition
description: Apply for the HICOOL Global Entrepreneurship Competition, the largest and most important annual startup event in China.

name: Call for Proposals: Pandemic Fund
description: El Fondo Pandémico ha abierto su segunda convocatoria de propuestas e invita a los Países Elegibles, Entidades Regionales y Entidades Ejecutoras interesados a desarrollar propuestas completas de posibles proyectos que puedan recibir apoyo de esta financiación inicial.

name: CFPs: Promoting Ecolabels and Sustainable Public Procurement In the Building and Construction Sector
description: El Programa de Información al Consumidor de la red One Planet (OPN) y el proyecto EcoAdvance, en colaboración con el Programa de Contratación Pública Sostenible de la red One Planet, lanzan una convocatoria de propuestas para aumentar el uso de ecoetiquetas (ISO 14024) y promover la contratación pública sostenible (CPS) como herramientas para mejorar la mitigación del cambio climático, la biodiversidad y la protección de los recursos en el sector de la edificación y la construcción.

name: International Green Gown Awards 2024
description: Los Premios Internacionales Green Gown, en asociación con Allianz Global Investors, cuentan con el apoyo del Programa de las Naciones Unidas para el Medio Ambiente y están abiertos a cualquier universidad o centro de enseñanza superior del mundo.
